notes:
Zone st_yard: the south part of the gravel yard of the quarry ground north of Yogi Berra Stadium, and the track along the outside of the stadium's left-field wall. Frame: model metres, +X east, +Y grid north.
The yard continues the overlook area's OV_road_quarry_yard across the shared edge y 1105 (same x positions there, 146.1 and 203.6, drawn to y 1105.4 for a 0.4 m overlap). Sources: NJ 2020 ortho (dark gravel, parked vehicles, a lighter pad at x 175..195, y 1093..1103) and the 2017 LiDAR ground (a flat floor at 108.3..108.7 m bounded by the bank on the west and the wooded rise on the east).
South end: the yard runs down to the stadium's sheds (ST_yogi_storage_CF, container and shed, kept 0.3..0.6 m clear) and to about 4 m short of the outfield wall; the strip between the wall and the yard stays lawn.
Track: a flat terrace 9 m wide in the LiDAR (108.6..108.9 m) along the outside of the left-field wall, grey and worn in the ortho; drawn 7 m wide, its south-east side 1.5 m clear of the wall, from the yard to where it disappears under trees at about (100, 1044).
